name: Cabeazy Virtual Try-On
author: invizioai

sections.description:
The virtual try-on button opens an AI fitting room on the WooCommerce product pages you choose. Shoppers can preview one item on their own photo or use the outfit builder to combine up to four pieces from your clothing and footwear catalogue.

Try before you buy in a virtual fitting room

A shopper comparing two jackets can see each one with the same trousers on their own photo. They can view the look from the front, side or back, then choose the size and colour of each piece they want to buy. WooCommerce handles the cart, prices and stock.

The try-on button and fitting room support English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese. The room opens in the language of the product page. Shoppers can switch languages during an outfit try-on.

See a WooCommerce outfit try-on and the installation steps.

The preview is created by AI. It gives an idea of the look. It does not show exact sizing, fit or drape, and the button says so.

What the merchant controls

  • Which apparel categories or individual products display the fitting room widget.
  • How many try-ons a visitor can use, and whether guests or only customers can use the room.
  • How long shopper photos and previews are kept. Shoppers can delete theirs from the fitting room.
  • The text of the button and of the note below it.
  • A [cabeazy] shortcode to place the button elsewhere on a product page.

A hosted service is required

This plugin is the connector to the Cabeazy fitting-room service, operated by Invizio AI. The service creates the images, so you need no API key and no account with an image provider. See “External services” below for what is sent and when.

The Discovery plan is free and includes 20 credits per 30 days. One new view of a single item uses one credit; one new view of an outfit of two to four items uses two credits. Zooming and reopening a saved result use no credits. Paid plans with larger allowances are shown in the setup screen before you activate anything; the fitting room stops at the allowance unless you choose otherwise.

Requirements

  • WooCommerce.
  • A site served over HTTPS and reachable from the internet (the service reads your product photos).
  • The PHP OpenSSL extension (the pairing code is stored encrypted).

External services

This plugin connects your store to the Cabeazy fitting-room service at https://cabeazy.invizioai.com, operated by Invizio AI. The plugin cannot create try-on previews without it.

Nothing is sent to the service until an administrator clicks “Connect my store” in WooCommerce > Cabeazy.

What is sent, and when:

  • When you connect the store: the site URL, its REST API URL and the URL of the Cabeazy admin screen, the site name, currency and time zone, the hosts that serve your product images, the WordPress, WooCommerce and plugin versions, and the site administration email (used for quota notices).
  • When you sync the catalogue (when you click “Sync catalogue”, and after product changes if automatic sync is on): published simple and variable products with their ID, name, URL, type, brand, categories, garment type, image URLs, price, stock status and variations.
  • Every five minutes while connected: a signed request that reads the fitting-room settings (active or not, eligible products, button label).
  • When you open the fitting room setup: a one-way hash that tells your WordPress users apart on the service (no name, no email address). The service answers with a single-use link valid for two minutes.
  • When a shopper opens the fitting room: the product and variation IDs, a random identifier kept in the shopper’s browser (local storage) to count their try-ons and, for a signed-in customer, their customer account number (no name, no email address). If you turn on the after-purchase bonus, a yes/no flag telling whether that customer has already bought from you.
  • In the fitting room: the fitting room is a frame served by the service. After giving consent, the shopper sends their photo directly to the service. The photo does not pass through WordPress.
  • If you turn on sales reporting in setup: for orders containing an item added from the fitting room, the order number, currency, dates, paid status and, for those items only, the line and variation numbers, amounts and refunds. No customer name, address or email.
  • When you use the WordPress personal data eraser: the customer account number, so the service deletes that customer’s try-ons.
  • When you disconnect the store or delete the plugin: a request to delete the pairing code and the retained photos.

To create the images, the service relies on a technical provider named in its privacy notice.

  • Service terms: https://cabeazy.invizioai.com/legal/woocommerce/terms-en.html
  • Privacy notice: https://cabeazy.invizioai.com/legal/woocommerce/privacy-en.html
  • Data processing agreement: https://cabeazy.invizioai.com/legal/woocommerce/data-processing-en.html
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install and activate Cabeazy Virtual Try-On.
  3. Open WooCommerce > Cabeazy and click “Connect my store”.
  4. Click “Sync catalogue”, then “Open fitting room setup”. Review the service terms, choose a plan, your eligible categories and your shopper limits, then activate the fitting room.
  5. Open an eligible product as a shopper and click “Try it on”.
sections.faq:
Can shoppers add individual pieces of an outfit to their WooCommerce cart?

Yes. They choose which items to buy and select a size and colour for each variable product. The plugin adds those variations to the existing WooCommerce cart. A shopper can try on a jacket and trousers together and buy just the jacket.

How can I track conversion after a virtual try-on?

If you enable try-on analytics, the Cabeazy dashboard shows which outfits shoppers chose to share and which pieces they added to the cart. Enable sales reporting to see purchases and refunds for those pieces.

Do I need an API key?

No. Image creation is part of the Cabeazy service.

Is it free?

The plugin is free. The service has a free Discovery plan with 20 credits per 30 days, and paid plans with larger allowances.

The button does not appear

In WooCommerce > Cabeazy, check that the fitting room is active and that the product is among the eligible products. Click “Refresh status”, then clear your page cache if you use one.

What happens when the allowance is used up?

The fitting room stops until the next period. Results already created remain available for as long as you keep them. On a paid plan you can choose to continue with a spending cap that you set.

Where do shopper photos go?

Directly from the fitting room to the service, after the shopper has given consent. They are kept for the period you choose in setup, then deleted. Shoppers can delete theirs at any time from the fitting room.

Does the preview show the exact fit?

No. It is an AI-generated preview of the look. It does not replace a size guide.
sections.changelog:
1.3.1

  • The try-on button now matches the store’s purchase button, including its colours, type and border. Set the cabeazy_button_look filter to outline to keep the outlined style.
  • Localized the storefront button, fitting room and cart messages for nine languages. Product names, sizes and prices continue to come from the store.

1.2.1

  • First release on WordPress.org.
